maria (People Ops): Quick ping 1 Jun update: Parental top-up pilot + mandatory Travel Code refresh for all business travel. Short TL;DR then details.

maria (People Ops): TL;DR: parental top-up: eligible parents can apply for a one-time 4-week paid top-up after statutory leave (apply within 6 months of return). Travel Code: all employees must re-acknowledge the Travel & Conduct code before booking international travel.

ethan (Eng): Who's eligible for the top-up?
tom (Benefits): Eligibility: full-time and part-time >=30 hrs/wk with at least 12 months tenure; managers must sign off. Contractors not eligible.
sophie (Recruiting): Is this retroactive for returns earlier this year?
maria (People Ops): If you returned within the last 90 days you can apply; payments processed in next payroll cycle after approval.

compliance-bot: Travel code reminder sent to all users; non-acknowledgement will block travel bookings after 2026-07-01.
maria (People Ops): Docs and application form: /policies/parental-topup and /policies/travel-code. We'll run two 15-min AMAs next Tue/Thu. DM me with questions. :heart:
